artifact_read.scope: Run-specific artifact endpoint only. No claim that every unrelated workflow artifact was downloaded or analyzed.

limitations: Provider queries are not atomic; each returned commit/run timestamp remains explicit. LRS changed during the probe and its later admission was read.
Unpublished NCP process state is unobserved; absence on these publication surfaces is not proof that no process exists.
The old full inventories were reused. Current branch-name/SHA diffs were computed for VigilODE and REI; other repositories use bounded updated-PR/Actions/push metadata and selected source receipts.
External result reports and identities are published primary evidence from their original lanes. Their benchmark measurements were not rerun and their speedups are not transferred to HE29.
No complete raw scientific archive replay; source/binary/table-scope classification precedes any future result analysis.
The recagent HTTP404 attempts are preserved as a corrected alias lookup, not an unresolved canonical repository access failure.
